invariants.rationale: The method will call data.collectAsList(), so data must not be null to avoid NullPointerException.
seqOp is method-applied in the reduction, so it must be non-null to ensure safe execution.
combOp is directly used in the reduction, so it must not be null.
zeroValue is passed as an identity to reduce; null may not always be safe or meaningful.
The stream is constructed over data.collectAsList(); this collection must not be null.
